title: trace() output does not appear in the Output panel (AVM1 trace suppressed by INFO filter)
description:
USER-REPORTED BUG — FIXED.

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed firsthand): RufflePlayer.tsx captured AS2 trace() by scraping console.log/console.warn and forwarding through shouldSuppressRuffleLog (ruffleLogFilter.ts). That filter suppresses any line whose stripped text starts with "info"/"avm" (RUFFLE_SUPPRESSED_PREFIXES). Ruffle emits trace() as a tracing INFO event on the avm_trace target, which the WASMLayer renders to the console as a styled "%cINFO%c ... avm_trace ... <msg>" line; after CSS stripping it starts with "INFO" -> matched the "info" prefix -> every trace line dropped before reaching onTrace/handleTrace, so OutputPanel stayed empty (placeholder only). Never worked (present since feat(0738)). The unit-test assumption "forwards plain AS2 trace() output" encoded the wrong premise.

SECONDARY (would have made a naive fix silently fail): Ruffle's bundled `set traceObserver(e){ this.instance?.set_trace_observer(e) }` is a no-op until load() creates the instance. The observer must be (re)registered AFTER load() resolves.

FIX:
- RufflePlayer.tsx: register Ruffle's dedicated trace observer (player.traceObserver = makeTraceObserver(() => onTraceRef.current)) which fires only for real avm_trace and bypasses the INFO console filter. Set both before load() (future-proof) and AFTER load() resolves (the binding that actually takes effect; in time for frame-1 trace). console.warn ERROR/WARN scraping kept for diagnostics; trace no longer routed through the suppressing console path.
- ruffle.d.ts: typed `traceObserver` setter on RufflePlayerElement.
- ruffleLogFilter.ts: added makeTraceObserver(getOnTrace) helper (lazy ref read).
- Updated the misleading filter test to pin the real behaviour (styled-INFO avm_trace console line stays suppressed; the observer carries trace).

TESTS / EVIDENCE (run in worktree; pnpm 9.15 / Node 22):
- pnpm --filter @flash/player run test  => 12 passed (was 8; +4 makeTraceObserver/observer-wiring tests).
- pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run => 1446 passed.
- pnpm --filter @flash/core run test -- --run => 5295 passed, 2 failed (+1 file 0 tests): the 3 KNOWN flash8-empty.fla fixture-missing failures (empty-bytematch / carchive-validate / contents-structure) — fixture absent in checkout, unrelated to this change.
- pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run => 653 passed.
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build => all packages build clean.
- E2E apps/desktop/e2e/trace-output.spec.ts (NEW) => 2 passed:
  (1) publishes a SWF with trace("hello from trace") on frame 1, loads it in the real bundled Ruffle, registers the SAME traceObserver channel, asserts the line arrives;
  (2) drives the in-app Control>Test Movie flow (Ctrl+Enter) and asserts "trace into output panel" appears in OutputPanel (data-testid="output-panel-messages"). Demonstrated locally with the gitignored Ruffle bundle copied into the worktree public/ (not committed).

Distinct from task 1120 (JSFL fl.trace(), different source path).
